claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The reference shows a black sports car with a carbon-fibre body on an empty showroom floor.
The showroom is dimly lit, with thin highlights travelling along the car's body panels as it moves.

description.text: , darkness pools in a wide, low-lit space. The black sports car waits there as little more than a silhouette; then it rolls slowly forward, its carbon-fibre body emerging into the dim showroom light. Thin highlights travel along the flanks and roofline as the car advances toward the foreground, revealing sculpted panels and a low nose. The movement is steady and unhurried, while the empty floor around it stays clear and quiet. As the car reaches the open floor, the engine note settles and the tyres whisper across the smooth surface. The car eases to a gradual halt, holding in the low light with the showroom stretching empty beyond it.
A low engine hum starts deep in the dark, swelling into a steady resonance that fills the still showroom.
